acceptanceCriteria: A Core-only candidate assembles with no companion input, with a test.
The companion path keeps its own required inputs and gate.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. Residual from V1-0125 (merged). docs/specs/corvint-1.0-product-and-release-v1.md PRS-V1-005 says a Core release candidate MUST NOT require companion input, but the review of V1-0125 found the assembler still requires it; cmd/corvint-companion-release/main.go:39 requires -tasks-root and the other companion inputs.

completion.reason: Delivered by PR #161 (merge 42a3e2e646674f4b2599a58b889e76902d7a5f09): a Core-only candidate assembles with no companion input, with a test; the companion path keeps its inputs (PRS-V1-005). full-gate NOT_RUN.

title: release: the Core-only candidate path still requires companion input (PRS-V1-005)
